h2: Moving the frontier without trading away safety, privacy, or ownership.

p: Most AI platforms ask you to pick two: raw capability, low latency, affordable cost, or control over your data. Chasing the Pareto frontier means advancing every axis at once through better systems engineering and open research.
Deterministic verification over guesswork

Generative models drift and hallucinate when left unchecked. We pair frontier reasoning with Kai calibrated discrete decision models, formal policy gates, and sandboxed execution so autonomous agents stay bounded in production.
Bare-metal C, CUDA, and Metal runtimes

Speed is an architectural choice. From Hanzo Engine’s zero-Python inference kernels and Kai’s decisions, which write no text, to Enso’s learned multi-model routing, every layer is engineered to maximize intelligence per millisecond.
Frontier capability without hyperscaler tax

Breakthrough AI cannot belong only to trillion-dollar incumbents. By routing each task to the most efficient model, publishing open weights, and pricing compute fairly, we put startups, researchers, and builders on equal footing.
1700+ public repositories since 2014

Our engines, agent SDKs, MCP servers, UI kits, and Hanzo Improvement Proposals (HIPs) are developed in the open. Anyone can inspect the code, verify how decisions are made, fork the stack, and contribute.
No training without your say

Business and API accounts are never used to train shared models unless an administrator or a written agreement says so, and a personal account only if you turn it on. Organizations sit in isolated tenant databases with scoped HKDF-SHA256 keys, local-first CLI workflows, and strict gateway identity stripping.
Cloud, private VPC, on-prem, or air-gapped

If you cannot move your weights, memory, and runtime onto your own hardware, you are renting your intelligence. Hanzo runs identically on our global cloud, inside your VPC, or completely air-gapped on your own GPUs.

h2: Built with founders, scaled to public markets.

p: From SKULLY and open-source commerce through Techstars ’17 to Damon Motors and Triller listing on Nasdaq in 2024, Hanzo has engineered sovereign commerce and AI systems for hundreds of venture-backed companies. Read the complete 2014–2026 archive on our history page, or start building today.
The principles the company argues from when a decision is close.
Enable others to win. Democratize technology so small businesses and startups can compete with industry giants.
Let data be your guide. Embrace analytics and AI as the foundation of decision-making.
Be open, share often. Openness accelerates growth—both for the company and its community.
Pivot with purpose. There is no failure, only feedback. Move quickly and strike in new directions when opportunity calls.
Treat each client as a long-term partner and guide them to success.
See the invisible, do the impossible. Boil problems down to their essence and solve them in fundamentally better ways.
Opaque black-box platforms ask you to trust what you cannot inspect. Hanzo pairs public source code and open specifications with calibrated decision bounds and full infrastructure sovereignty.
Auditable infrastructure from kernel to interface

Since open-sourcing our commerce architecture in 2014, we have published over 1700 public repositories. From C/CUDA/Metal inference engines to agent compilers, MCP tools, and cross-platform UI kits, our stack is built to be read, audited, and extended.
Zero Proprietary Lock-In: Export and run models, agents, and state on your own hardware without rewriting application code.
HIP Standards: Core protocols and architectures published openly through Hanzo Improvement Proposals.
Shared Ecosystem: MCP servers, skills, UI primitives, and inference runtimes built in public with contributors worldwide.
Calibrated decisions, not guesswork

Unconstrained token generators drift in high-stakes workflows. Hanzo puts calibrated decisions (Kai), policy checks and isolated sandboxes in front of any autonomous agent that touches production data or billing.
Policy Governance: Policy checks stop a tool call or a change your policy refuses before it is sent.
Sovereign & Air-Gapped: Run inside your own VPC or offline cluster with zero external telemetry or third-party relays.
Calibrated Confidence: Kai returns calibrated probability distributions and defers cleanly when evidence is insufficient.
